data.gender_notes: Aznarun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aznarun is of Islamic origin and means 'Jasmine flower'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'az-zananir', meaning 'jasmine'. Jasmine is a beautiful and fragrant flower that symbolizes gentleness, grace, and beauty. It is often used in perfumes and as a symbol of love and devotion. The name Aznarun carries the meaning “Jasmine flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Aznarun usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder to always strive for inner beauty and to spread the fragrance of love and kindness to others.
